Total appears to be around 10 distinct individuals actively involved or pulling/pushing. However, let's re-examine if any are missed. In frame 1975.2s:
Left side: Orange, Red/white, Dark shirt, Plaid shirt = 4 people on sand pushing front/left.
On boat: Two men sitting/holding sides = 2 people.
Right side: Man in red with backpack, man in white hat, man in white long sleeve, plus one more person whose arm/shoulder is visible on the far right edge (wearing dark/purple). That makes at least 5 on the right/on-deck total.

Total = 4 (left sand) + 2 (on boat) + 3 (right sand clear view) + 1 (far right partial) = 10 people clearly visible participating.

Therefore, the count is 10.
